cardSummary: Use concrete behavioral scenarios to understand decision-making under uncertainty, bias, loss aversion, and emotional regulation.

lessons.title: 8.2 Cognitive Biases
lessons.summary: Human beings do not make decisions like perfect machines.

lessons.title: 8.3 Prospect Theory and Loss Aversion
lessons.summary: Many beginners think the hardest part of trading is finding the right setup.

lessons.title: 8.4 Emotional Regulation in Trading
lessons.summary: Traders do not become better by pretending they have no emotions.
